workloads.name: request_data_validation
workloads.expression: payload.name.size() >= 3 && payload.tags.size() > 0 && payload.tags.size() <= 5 && payload.tags[0] != "" && payload.email.endsWith("@example.com") && payload.region.contains("us-") && payload.metadata["source"] == "api"

workloads.name: cart_validation
workloads.expression: cart.items.size() > 0 && cart.items.size() <= 50 && cart.items.all(item, item.quantity > 0 && item.quantity <= stock[item.sku] && item.price > 0 && item.price * item.quantity <= 100000) && cart.coupons.all(code, code in ['WELCOME', 'LOYALTY'])

workloads.name: temporal_authorization
workloads.expression: timestamp(request.now) >= timestamp(grant.starts) && timestamp(request.now) < timestamp(grant.expires) && timestamp(request.now).getDayOfWeek('America/New_York') in [1,2,3,4,5] && timestamp(request.now).getHours('America/New_York') >= 9 && timestamp(request.now).getHours('America/New_York') < 17 && duration(job.elapsed) <= duration('30s')

workloads.name: quota_and_permissions
workloads.expression: math.bitAnd(account.permissions, 4) == 4 && request.units > 0 && math.isFinite(request.cpu) && math.ceil(request.cpu) <= limits.cpu && math.greatest(request.units, account.used + request.units) <= limits.units && math.abs(request.delta) <= limits.max_delta

workloads.name: batch_dispatch
workloads.expression: request.enabled && request.slots > 0 && request.batches.flatten().size() >= request.slots && request.batches.flatten().map(j, j.id).distinct().size() == request.batches.flatten().size() && request.batches.flatten().sortBy(j, j.priority).slice(0, request.slots).all(j, j.ready && j.cost <= request.max_cost) && request.nodes.size() >= request.slots && lists.range(request.slots).all(i, request.nodes[i].free)

workloads.name: text_ingestion
workloads.expression: cel.bind(name, request.name.trim().lowerAscii().replace(' ', '-'), name.matches('^[a-z-]+$') && request.labels.split(',').map(x, x.trim().upperAscii()).join('|') == 'ADMIN|READ' && request.revision >= 0 && '%s:%d'.format([name, request.revision]) == request.key && name.substring(0,1) != '-')

workloads.name: attachment_ingestion
workloads.expression: request.enabled && request.media_type == 'text/plain' && cel.bind(data, base64.decode(request.payload), data.size() <= request.max_bytes && data == bytes(request.expected) && base64.encode(data) == request.canonical)
